runner_decision_checklist.headline: What families need before race morning at Peachtree Middle School.
runner_decision_checklist.intro: A clear summary of the date, location, parking, packet pickup, awards, and official RunSignup registration path.

items.label: Race date
items.detail: The 2026 race is scheduled for Saturday, November 7.

items.label: Start/finish area
items.detail: The 5K is centered at Peachtree Middle School, 4664 North Peachtree Road, and starts and finishes around the school track.

items.label: Parking
items.value: Peachtree Middle School, Brook Run Park, and Chesnut Elementary if needed
items.detail: Race-morning parking is available at these school and park locations.

items.label: Bib/shirt pickup
items.value: Nov. 5, Nov. 6, and race morning windows
items.detail: Race bib/shirt pickup is Thursday, November 5 from 4:30–6:30 PM in front of the school, Friday, November 6 from 1:00–3:00 PM in front of the school, and Saturday, November 7 from 6:30–7:30 AM at the track.

items.label: Awards
items.detail: Awards include top male/female overall, top masters male/female overall, and top three male/female in age groups from 10 and under through 60 and over.

items.label: Current prices
items.detail: Current base prices apply to each public entry option before RunSignup processing fees.

story.title: Run, walk, volunteer, and support Whole Student Wellness.
paragraphs: The CV Classic is an annual 5K road race for Peachtree Middle School that raises funds while promoting cardiovascular health and Whole Student Wellness for students, faculty, and the community.
The 2026 race morning is centered at Peachtree Middle School, with race-day registration from 7:00 to 7:30 AM, the 5K at 8:00 AM, and an awards ceremony scheduled for 9:00 AM.
Families can choose standard 5K participation, a family sponsorship with a 5K participant, or a Phantom Runner support option for supporters who are not running.

faqs.question: Where does the CV Classic take place?
faqs.answer: The race page includes Peachtree Middle School at 4664 North Peachtree Road in Dunwoody, GA, and the description says the race starts and finishes around the school track.

faqs.question: What race options are listed?
faqs.answer: The race page includes a 5K Participant option, a Family Sponsorship w/ 5K Participant option, and a Phantom Runner support option.

faqs.question: When is packet pickup?
faqs.answer: The race page includes race bib/shirt pickup Thursday, November 5 from 4:30–6:30 PM in front of the school, Friday, November 6 from 1:00–3:00 PM in front of the school, and Saturday, November 7 from 6:30–7:30 AM at the track.

faqs.question: What are the awards categories?
faqs.answer: The race page includes top male and female overall, top masters male and female overall, and top three male/female finishers in each listed age group.

faqs.question: How do I contact the race?
faqs.answer: Use the official RunSignup contact form for race questions.
